problem: Display.drawPixel writes a framebuffer-backed panel without opening a transaction, so auto-display never sees endWrite and a standalone call does not flush.
correction: Wrap the Python drawPixel call in a nested-safe startWrite/endWrite transaction; an existing user transaction remains open until its matching endWrite.
validation: StopWatch matching preimage misses both standalone pixels; StopWatch, StickS3 and Core2 candidates pass odd/even standalone pixels, framebuffer neighbor preservation and an explicit outer startWrite/endWrite batch.
